meta.title: Plans — NestSelf
meta.description: Three plans for organisations of every size. Essentials, Complete and Enterprise — priced per eligible employee per month.

hero.title: Choose the right plan for your organisation
hero.lead: Every plan includes confidential access to licensed professionals and a launch toolkit. Pick the scope that fits your team.

tiers.name: Essentials
tiers.audience: For organisations starting with core psychological support.
includes: Therapy & Counselling with licensed psychologists and qualified psychotherapists
Resources: articles, guides and self-help tools
Webinars: live and on-demand expert sessions

tiers.name: Complete
tiers.audience: For organisations that want the full wellbeing benefit.
includes: Legal Consultation on personal legal matters
Manager support: polls, conversation guides, briefings

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.audience: For multi-country organisations with advanced needs.

note: Priced per eligible employee per month. Your quote is based on headcount, countries and plan.

items.title: Confidentiality
items.body: Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR sees anonymised usage for groups of 10 or more.

items.title: Serbian, Hungarian and English
items.body: Sessions, resources and communications materials in the languages your people speak.

items.title: Launch toolkit
items.body: Announcement emails, posters and intranet materials — prepared in your chosen languages and ready to go.

items.title: Accessibility
items.body: The platform is designed to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA, so every employee can use it comfortably.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Plans are priced per eligible employee per month. Your quote is based on headcount, countries and plan. Request a demo and we will prepare a quote for you.

items.question: Is there a minimum company size?
items.answer: NestSelf works for organisations of all sizes. Contact us and we will find the right plan for your team.

items.question: Can we start with Essentials and upgrade later?
items.answer: Yes. You can move to Complete or Enterprise at any time. Your NestSelf contact will help you plan the transition.

items.question: Do you offer a trial period?
items.answer: We can discuss a pilot programme as part of your demo. Contact us to learn more.

items.question: What is included in the launch toolkit?
items.answer: Announcement emails, posters, intranet materials and a manager briefing — all in your chosen languages.

items.question: How quickly can we launch?
items.answer: From signed agreement to employee access in two to four weeks, depending on the size of your organisation and the number of languages.

cta.title: Request a quote
cta.body: Tell us about your organisation and we will prepare a plan and a quote.
